item.title: Macrogenics Manufacturing Sale
item.description:
• Summary: MacroGenics sold its manufacturing arm to Bora Pharmaceuticals for $127 million, part of a strategic shift to an asset-light model. The sale includes a biologics manufacturing facility and CDMO operations. The move comes as MacroGenics focuses on its pipeline of oncology therapeutics.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, ApexOnco, Fierce Pharma

item.title: Takeda Layoffs
item.description:
• Summary: Takeda announced layoffs affecting 4,500 employees as part of a broader transformation program. The restructuring aims to streamline operations and reduce costs amid patent expiries and pipeline challenges. The cuts represent a significant workforce reduction.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace, STAT News

item.title: Zydus Acquires Assertio
item.description:
• Summary: Zydus Lifesciences has agreed to acquire Assertio Therapeutics, expanding its specialty pharmaceutical portfolio.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Eli Lilly UNICEF Donation
item.description:
• Summary: Eli Lilly donated $50 million to UNICEF to support pediatric health initiatives globally, enhancing access to medicines and healthcare for children.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Aptose Cash Crunch
item.description:
• Summary: Aptose Biosciences faces a cash crunch and exits a blood cancer development pact after Hanmi Pharmaceutical's buyout blocked further progress, raising concerns about the company's financial viability.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
